title: every correction axis closed on the OLD base (LGBM_B3), re-measured on the NEW base (C5_B3) — logit coordinate, d_r solo and joint, pitcher-hand-2 league ablation, backoff coverage.  No training.
BASE_VALIDITY_WARNING: every number here is measured on the exp_030 C5_B3 base as it stands (stage-2 iteration policy, fold_2024 stacker fixed at 481 rounds).  exp_032 is repairing that base's iteration policy.  If it succeeds, the LEVELS here go stale; the DIRECTIONS (which axis helps, which hurts) are expected to carry, and re-measuring the winner on a repaired base costs under a minute.

conversion.caveat: every Brier here is full precision, so the +-0.20 rounding caveat does NOT apply

arms_declared.R0: no correction — p as C5_B3 produced it
arms_declared.R1: p + beta*d, cell S400_self, beta 0.59072 (exp_031's block-selected configuration).  THE CONTROL.
arms_declared.LG1: sigmoid(logit(p) + gamma*d), cell S400_self, gamma 2.382309 from offset.fit_gamma on the supply blocks
arms_declared.LG2: LG1 with gamma re-searched on an explicit 42-point block grid; block argmin gamma = 2.382309
arms_declared.DR1: p + beta_r*d_r, cell R200_self chosen on the block surface (20 declared cells), beta_r -0.304966
arms_declared.DR2: p + beta_s*d_s(S400_self) + beta_r*d_r(R200_self), both fitted jointly (2x2 normal equations, no intercept)
arms_declared.AB1: R1's cell S400_self with L := 0 on every pitcher_hand-2 row; beta refitted on the supply
arms_declared.AB2: R1's cell S400_self with L := 0 on pitcher_hand-2 CELL-MISS rows only; beta refitted on the supply
arms_declared.BK1: hard backoff: league term on cell-MISS rows only, pure personal deviation on hit rows, k = 400 (cell S400_self).  On this base that IS the control's cell.
arms_declared.BK1b_DIAGNOSTIC: hard backoff at the OLD candidate-H shrink constant (cell S111_self).  Not a pre-registered arm; reported so the 'candidate H configuration' reading of BK1 is also on the record.
arms_declared.BK2: soft shrinkage: the league term reaches HIT rows too with weight k/(n+k), k = 400 (cell S400_league).  exp_031's fold_2024 oracle cell and the OLD base's selected cell.

gate4_label_isolation.note: no model is fitted here.  The recovered labels enter ONLY as the numerators of frozen season-as-of tables (`succ` for d_s, `rev` for d_r); check (b) below proves no row-level label reached a row's own deviation.

gate5_asof_independent.method: row_id -> season re-read from train.csv in a SECOND pass; the max season of the CONTRIBUTING ROW IDS is looked up in that independent map.  This covers both numerators (`succ` and `rev`) because both tables use the identical row mask.

gate6_devgen_equivalence.what: devgen.py is dev_k.build_multi_k / backoff.build_league_dev with the numerator key lifted to an argument.  Running it at key='succ' must reproduce the audited modules BIT for BIT; that is what licenses running it at key='rev'.

gate7_exp031_record_copies_agree.what: the exp_031 metrics.json copied up from the laptop vs the metrics_grid.json the exp_031 run left on the server.  The laptop copy carries an extra report_derived block, so only the sections this file READS are compared.

coordinate_divergence.note: v = p(1-p) is the local slope dp/dz of the logit map.  When its coefficient of variation is small, sigmoid(logit(p)+g*d) is p + g*v_mean*d to first order, i.e. the linear arm with beta = g*v_mean -- the two coordinate systems then cannot meaningfully disagree.  The clip is NOT the mechanism here: n_rows_clipped_linear is reported and is 0.

ds_dr_correlation_MEASURED.measured_on: this run, on THIS base's deviation vectors.  The deviations come from the labels only, so they do NOT depend on the base -- which is exactly why the old-base row below should agree, and is reported next to it as a check rather than copied over.

old_base_exp026_exp028_READ.note: exp_026/exp_028 built the SAME tables from the SAME labels, so the raw-deviation correlations must agree with this run to float noise.  The arm-level correlations need not: the old base paired the d_s arm at k400 x LEAGUE, this run's control cell is k400 x SELF.

ablation_scope.rule_AB1: L := 0 on EVERY pitcher_hand == 2 row (exp_025 B_ph1only's rule)
ablation_scope.rule_AB2: L := 0 only where pitcher_hand == 2 AND the personal cell is EMPTY (exp_026 C1's rule)
ablation_scope.STRUCTURAL_NOTE: the control cell is S400_self — target `self`.  Under `self` the league term is added ONLY on cell-miss rows, so zeroing L on ph2 HIT rows is a no-op and AB1 and AB2 collapse onto the same arm.  That is a property of the NEW base's selected cell; on the old base's `league` cell they differ, and the league_cell_DIAGNOSTIC rows below measure by how much.

old_base_exp026_C1_scope_READ.differs_from_exp025_B_ph1only: exp_025 zeroed L on ALL pitcher-hand-2 rows, hit rows included; this zeroes only the miss rows

BK2.block_gap_note: the block surface preferred `self` over `league` at k=400 by this margin.  It is thin; exp_031 measured per-cell seed std of 3-4 score points on the old base's equivalent surface, so this margin does not separate the two cells.

adoption.rule: 3 seeds same sign AND |mean delta| >= 3 x CONTROL seed std.  NOT relaxed.
adoption.label_warning: MULTIPLE_OF_THE_THRESHOLD and MULTIPLE_OF_THE_CONTROL_STD differ by exactly 3x.  They are NOT interchangeable and must never be compared across experiments without first checking which one the other experiment reported.  exp_031 reported a CONTROL-STD multiple of 2.464 and a THRESHOLD multiple of 0.821 for the same measurement.
adoption.control_choice_note: exp_031's control was R0 (the uncorrected base), whose seed std was smaller; every arm here varies the offset, so the control is R1 and the bar is correspondingly HIGHER.  The R0-referenced numbers are given separately below and must not be mixed.

old_base_side_by_side.WARNING: TWO DIFFERENT BASES.  The old rows are LGBM_B3 (exp_025/026/028); the new rows are C5_B3 (exp_030/031).  Brier LEVELS are not commensurable and must never be pooled.  Only the DIRECTION and the ORDER OF MAGNITUDE of a delta transfer.

ablation.old_exp025_denominator: gain of k400xleague OVER the DEPLOYED k111xself d, NOT over no-offset

old_recomputed_on_the_no_offset_denomina.why: exp_025's headline 83.5% used the DEPLOYED k111xself arm as the denominator.  This run's denominator is no-offset, so the old ratio is recomputed on the same denominator here.  Quoting 83.5% next to this run's ratio without this line would compare two different quantities.

report_derived_regeneration_check.method: report_derived is rebuilt from a JSON round-trip of the primary sections only (report_derived itself excluded) and compared byte for byte.  Every number quoted in report.md comes from report_derived, so this check is what makes the report reproducible from metrics.json alone.
